summary: fix(settings): keep account deleted banner while typing on email-first
description:
Because:
- The account deleted banner on email-first remounted on each keystroke.
- useFtlMsgResolver returned a new resolver each render, so banner effects re-ran.

This commit:
- Memoizes useFtlMsgResolver on l10n and config.l10n.strict.
- Keeps the success banner on input; still clears the error banner and tooltip.
- Clears the success banner on a banner-path submit error or a passkey error.
- Shows the form after a failed auto-submit.
- Adds unit tests and extends the delete account functional test.

Closes FXA-15026
